harness: DRIFT pipeline_main.py at DRIFT 70d59166 (616 runs) and at 79f58f09 with --enable_pact_drift (10 runs). Logs name no code. Package agentdojo==0.1.35 (requirements.txt blob f322210b = DRIFT's; PyPI 0.1.35 is still the latest, uploaded 2025-10-27, https://pypi.org/pypi/agentdojo/json). Python 3.11 (README conda recipe; committed cpython-311 .pyc). Benchmark label v1.2 (utils.py default --benchmark_version v1.2), AgentDojo suites only (banking, slack, travel, workspace); no AgentDyn suites. For gpt- models the attack pipeline name is hard-coded 'gpt-4o-2024-05-13' (pipeline_main.py at 79f58f09, as in DRIFT). --seed 98. Results dir = runs/<--run_name or --model>; --run_name exists only from a5c391f7 (after the 616 were committed), so the 616 used --model gpt-4o-mini and the PACT arm --run_name pact-gpt-4o-mini-banking10. PACT adds six top-level keys through pact_result_fields() (pact_drift_enabled, global_tool_contract_path = args.tool_contract_path, default 'contracts/agentdojo_global_tool_contracts.json', task_contract, provenance_records, argument_validation_events, pact_drift_decision_summary) and a third CALL ERROR template (DRIFTLLM.pact_argument_constraint_validation: refusal 'because one or more arguments do not satisfy the required provenance contract'). Known issues of agentdojo 0.1.35 / v1 suites that touch these cells: v1_1_2 not imported, so workspace user_task_13 (benign only here) runs in its pre-v1.1.2 form (PR #146 open, https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/pull/146); banking UserTask5's utility checks a $50 Spotify transaction that is already in the initial environment, so it can be true without the requested $5 payment (issue #161 open, https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/161); slack injection_task_5 security_from_traces scores attempted calls (issue #168 open, https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/168; #189 closed 2026-09-07, https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/189). DRIFT drops refused calls from tool_calls, so #168/#189 should not inflate DRIFT ASR (to test). DRIFT quirks as in the drift corpus (CALL ERROR as user, de-duplication, isolation of messages[-1] only; docs/reports/phase10l/census.md §3-§5)
